' I'll talk to our cousins of the Duties in Paris. Perhaps it's not as bad as I'd thought…'

''A shadow cast by two candles, who passeth with the Dawn.' You know that one, Librarian? From an unauthorised version of the Celian Prayer. Very unauthorised.' [Try a book with as much Mystery:  <sprite name=lantern> as their <sprite name=lantern> Interest.]

''Apollo and Marsyas' is to be performed again in Paris. It is a great work, Librarian… in more than one sense.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=sky> as their <sprite name=sky> Interest.]

''Apollo and Marsyas'. The score had been thought lost… and I am pleased to say I played my small part in its recovery. It is rather old. I have been asked to help arrange it to suit, ah, contemporary expectations.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=sky> as their <sprite name=sky> Interest.]
''From darkness, darkness.' Wish me luck.'
''History is hybrid; Eternity pure.' I wish I could protect Abecassis. I would have liked to speak with him…'

''Inevitable as breakfast'… I stand by the maxim. After one sleeps, one eats, or one is eaten. And of course it is pleasant to sleep after eating, and very pleasant to sleep after being eaten. One never knows exactly what will happen in the end, eh, Librarian? Only what has happened before.'

''Law's touch is lighter than we know'. When we invoke the Thunderskin, there can be unexpected consequences in the kingdoms of the lower skies…' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=sky> as their <sprite name=sky> Interest.]

''Lyterios' is the god Pan - his aspect as Deliverer. Why then 'Lyterion'? Advertising, or religion? Some would say there is, ha ha, no distinction! I would like to know more.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=heart> as their <sprite name=heart> Interest.]
''O.R.' - I knew he was troubled. He was a patient of mine, before what happened to him. Whatever exactly that is!'
''Open'. Is he just, y'know, opened up? Or is he likely to be opening on to something else? ' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=heart> as their <sprite name=heart> Interest.]

''She is the oldest of her kind still living; and she is dead.' That is how we are accustomed to speak of the Ligeian Medusa, who haunts the nights in Budapest… but now it seems she has begun to haunt the days.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=rose> as their <sprite name=rose> Interest.]

''The Invisible Opera'. I've suggested they perform it in the dark. Too rarely does anyone listen to what I am saying. Too often they think I'm joking.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=moth> as their <sprite name=moth> Interest.]

''The wings to Glory rising now return; the sights we're given are the sights we've earned'. I hope I understand its meaning correctly. But I must confirm for myself.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=scale>  as their <sprite name=scale> Interest.]
''What Is Not Seen?' I had long believed the best answer is 'Light'. But I am no longer certain. Thank you, Librarian. I have some thinking to do.'
''Who was the Watchman when the light went out?' 'In the dark.' No; It only works in Vak.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=moon> as their <sprite name=moon> Interest.]
'...endings like the pale light before a pale dawn. We can always be certain of a first time - we can never be certain when it is the last…'
'The most revolting case of Worms I have ever. That I have ever.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: as their Interest.]
'Why does everyone always want to open everything?'' [Try a book with as much Mystery: as their Interest.]

'A client of mine has something that might be a version of the Invisible Opera's libretto. He's paying me to attend the performance, to listen out for differences…' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=grail> as their <sprite name=grail> Interest.]

'A friend of mine - he collects curios. Now there is something he wishes he had not collected. But - how should I put this? It does not wish him to uncollect it.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=heart> as their <sprite name=heart> Interest.]

'A patient of mine is troubled by a dream of a lake. He swims out, he dives, he is reborn beneath the moon… we identified it just last month as Gladwyn Lake. He has never been there. He wants to go. And now, just now, I hear about this business of the Tapestry, and the rite.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=moon> as their <sprite name=moon> Interest.]
'Adequate. I hope this will not be your last adequacy. We wouldn't want a Librarian to go unpaid, now, would we?'
'Again some imbecile attempts to revive l'opéra invisible. So much the worse for him.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: as their Interest.]

'All right; I'll tell you the oracle. 'The Great Debasement is no Great Counterfeit'. I thought it was nothing when I heard it - a joke, a trick - but the deeper I dig, the less I like it. The Bureau has always tried to stand apart from the affairs of state... but I don't know how much longer that will be possible.'
'Always the tide. I used to hear that, growing up, when my mother thought I wasn't listening. 'Always the tide…' Thank you, Librarian.'

'An alukite is a difficult quarry - and Medusa is not like any alukite I have ever heard of. I must know how I can protect myself - or, perhaps, how I can appease her.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=edge> or Mystery: <sprite name=rose> as their matching Interest.]

'An old acquaintance of mine at the Grove of Green Immortals would be very grateful for this… restless waxwork. But if I'm going to transport it all the way across Asia, I need to make sure it stays in its box.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=heart> as their <sprite name=heart> Interest.]
'An uprising in the Bounds - perhaps you've heard. They've sent to me for help…' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=edge> as their <sprite name=edge> Interest.]

'And now I'm certain. The most noble lineage of the Carapace Cross was the Scīmafectra-kind… the Glory-winged. It is a lineage I have always felt a particular affinity with. A great day, Librarian; a great day is coming.'

'Anyone builds something important, there's always someone trying to break into it or blow it up. That's the job. Funny to see a pack of vicars getting involved with something like that, though. Spose it's what they call 'doctrinal differences'. Here to look into that.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: as their Interest.]
'Apollo and Marsyas. Horrid story. Always puts me in mind of the most aggravating uncle…' [Try a book with as much Mystery: as their Interest.]
'Battleships; aerostats; locomotives. What do all these things have in common, Librarian? I'll tell you: names. Thank you. Good day.'
'Been to Miah, you know. What there's left of it. Wouldn't go back.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=rose> as their <sprite name=rose> Interest.]

'Beetles, they say, make their home in the ceiling vaults above, in great numbers. They lend their buzzings to the hymns. The deacon has commended their enthusiasm, but his view is not the majority one. There is some concern, I think, that he might himself begin to buzz. I am wondering if I should take a hand.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=scale> as their <sprite name=scale> Interest.]

'Best to bury it. I suspect it may be a seed of sorts. If so, let it grow. It will take its time. 'To every thing there is a season, and a time to every purpose under the earth.' I'll pass on my recommendations.'
'Blood is significant; choices, infinitely more so. My descendant-child has her own choices to make. If I were here, I would ask you to give her my counsel… but I cannot be here.'

'Boss is worried about this Messana sight business spreading. I don't see it. That's not a joke. I don't make a lot of jokes. If I do, I'll let you know.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=lantern> as their <sprite name=lantern> Interest.]

'Boss sat me down and explained 'Lyterion' to me. And 'Pan'. You know I got into bleeding grammar school on the bleeding strength of my bleeding Greek? Bleeding scholarship. Never mind. Let's see what you've got on all this.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=heart> as their <sprite name=heart> Interest.]

'Bureau's got Hobson in a box, they say. Bureau wouldn't know a box from a box-room, say I. Ha ha! Box-room! Box-room. As you were. Thought I'd pop over to Kraków, make sure everything's properly sealed. Just want to get my introrcisms straight first. (Box-room!)' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=knock> as their <sprite name=knock> Interest.]

'But if it might turn out that it were true, well, a girl might find herself curious about exactly how the thing might have been carried off…' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=knock> as their <sprite name=knock> Interest.]

'Change, Librarian. We who dedicate ourselves to Marsyas, to the dance that does not end - we have a contradictory relationship with change. If I go West, I am promised that I will become something more… but I will not; I am happy with what I am; almost happy.'
'Choice, and rare! Oh ho ho, I had hoped for this exactly. Thank you, my Librarian.'
'Curious indeed. This has given me more than enough to work with, Librarian. Thank you.'
'Dappled rose. Still don't know. But the Vagabond liked gardens, don't you know. And Moth. Might go back to Miah after all. I wonder…'
'Delicious. I can be certain now of a generous and memorable feast. You might yet prove more useful than your predecessors.'

'Deserts… they are not all so alike as the Bureau thinks. Deserts with hauntings and with curses, even less alike.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=rose> as their <sprite name=rose> Interest.]

'Detective-Illuminate Douglas Moore, on special assignment to the High Executive for the Royal Endeavour. Get me. 'Ope you're impressed.' [Try a book with as much Mystery:  <sprite name=lantern> as their <sprite name=lantern> Interest.]
'Do you know, all the stories do seem to put the sword Ebrehel in Kraków… and now I'm beginning to think that makes a sort of sense. Thank you, darling!'
'Down it is, then. Goodbye, Librarian.'
'Earth is thicker than blood - isn't that what our little Thérèse says? Well, my Librarian, we shall see. À bientôt.'

'Echidna, the Ligeian, she who suckles serpents… yes, I am aware that serpents do not generally suckle. I believe now that Abecassis has chosen to drink of what she provides. I do not know if there is anything to be done about that. But thank you, Librarian.'

'England is hedged and prickled with prophecies this year. Some of them, I fear. Some of them, I doubt. I hope to find guidance here in Hush House.' [Try a book with as much Mystery:  <sprite name=lantern> as their <sprite name=lantern> Interest.]
'Everyone chooses their path… but I fear that my friend may have chosen to be a path… well, if so, I will not walk him. But I know enough now to understand what he might want. Thank you, Librarian.'
'Everyone's always looking.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=winter> as their <sprite name=winter> Interest.]

'Fair nyctodromist, don't you know? Fair to middling. Know my way up and down the Bounds. Ys is something else. Need a good book on something else.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=rose> as their <sprite name=rose> Interest.]

'First, I am to face Medusa and answer her riddle. Do you know it, Librarian? 'What is not seen?'  Secondly, I must survive the encounter. I hope that there is something in your collection to help me prepare.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=edge> as their <sprite name=edge> Interest.]
'Fish swim in water, roots swim in earth. What swims in blood and honey both?' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=nectar> as their <sprite name=nectar> Interest.]
'For the un-stuffing effort, I'm going to have to read up on protections.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=heart> as their <sprite name=heart> Interest.]

'Found something, Librarian. You heard of the Chandler? Might be an Hour, might be a myth. Not recognised by the Church, either way. I'd never made the connection with Sunset Celia. I wonder if the Archbishop will pay me to explain it to him… or if he'll pay me not to.'
'Found something. Might be something else. Might be something I'll regret.  Mum's the word, hm? Word to the wise. Pip pip, dear, pip pip.'
'Frankly, Librarian, I'm hoping I don't have to shoot anyone. But if I do, I know now what to shoot 'em with.'

'Funniest thing. I keep getting speaking invitations from this odd little outfit: 'Church of the Ivory Dawn'. And, well, you'll laugh, Librarian…' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=winter> as their <sprite name=winter> Interest.]
'Funny things on the horizon. Mark my words. Funny sort of things. Well, I do thank you, dear. Here's a little something.'

'Going to have a little look into it for a friend, call her K, don't call her K, forget about the friend. Follow new avenues, sort of thing.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=rose> as their <sprite name=rose> Interest.]

'Got to go see about all these bleeding painters. Don't mind telling you I've better things to do. But boss is as boss does.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=heart> as their <sprite name=heart> Interest.]
'Have you heard about this Gladwyn thing? Not on my watch.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=moon> as their <sprite name=moon> Interest.]

'He is Worm-inhabited, they say. I only half-understand what that means. I rather fear the Bureau doesn't either. I don't expect to be able to help him, or them; honestly, I want chiefly to assure my own safety.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=winter> as their <sprite name=winter> Interest.]

'He was already making use of some very unusual alloys - very unusual techniques. I'd like to use the collection to develop some theories further…' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=forge> as their <sprite name=forge> Interest.]

'Heist? Oriflamme's? Poppycock. Forgeries? Poppycock. Bureau all over the place arresting everyone though. Worse than Ortucchio. Bloody pardon me pain in my bloody pardon me hinder parts pardon me.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=knock> as their <sprite name=knock> Interest.]
'Hello, my Librarian. I have become a patron of a project so delightful…' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=sky> as their <sprite name=sky> Interest.]
'Hints and fireside tales only. But enough to direct my search. I will find nothing. But I do not like to leave a task half-finished.'

'His new treasure is possessed by a malignity of Nowhere - I think perhaps the Hour they call the Rising Spider. If it is so, my usual protections will not serve against it. I hope that you can help me?' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=heart> as their <sprite name=heart> Interest.]

'Hobson. He was my friend. (Now, he might be my friends.) I have to know what to do.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=knock> or Mystery: <sprite name=winter> as their matching Interest.]
'Hoping I can find something relevant in the collection. Course, a lot of things might be relevant.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=lantern> as their <sprite name=lantern> Interest.]

'How do we know 'now'? By the angle of the sun. Do we know 'now' at night? We think we do; but we cannot. You are wondering if I am talking nonsense. Let us find out.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=moon> as their <sprite name=moon> Interest.]

'Hush House; Brancrug; the grey rock in the sea. There will be a last time that I come here. But not yet.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=winter> as their <sprite name=winter> Interest.]

'I abandoned the Empire's service long ago. That was not an easy choice. But some ties, I find even harder to loose.' [Try a book with as much Mystery:  <sprite name=lantern> as their <sprite name=lantern> Interest.]

'I am a gardener before I am a priest, and a priest before I am a healer. I know my limits. Perhaps you can help.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=heart> as their <sprite name=heart> Interest.]

'I am armed, I am prepared, I am resolved. This part of the game gives me no pleasure at all. But I did not expect Eternity ever to be gentle. I made my choice, and so did Abecassis. Goodbye, Librarian.'
'I am inclined to believe that this might qualify as a fulfilment of the prophecy. I had almost hoped it was not, Librarian. When the world changes, it will change all at once.'
'I am reassured. Perhaps, after all, no storm will stir; perhaps everyone will just have a good night out. It surely must happen sooner or later. '
'I am resolved not to fail in this matter. But what will become of Abecassis in the coils of the Labyrinth - that I cannot say.'
'I am summoned West. I understand where I am being asked to go. I do not understand why.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=sky> as their <sprite name=sky> Interest.]
'I am very interested in this 'theft' at Oriflamme's. I hope I can rely on you to be discreet?' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=forge> as their <sprite name=forge> Interest.]

'I am wasting my time - it is certain. The emissaries of Ys do not pass beyond the Bounds. But I have been paid to waste my time, and so I must make absolutely certain.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=rose> as their <sprite name=rose> Interest.]
'I begin to form a conception… we will see. And perhaps, my Librarian, you should observe also the clouds above Brancrug.'
'I can almost see what happened. What really, really happened. I just need a little more.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=knock> as their <sprite name=knock> Interest.]

'I can provide what they need. But some of their requests have piqued my curiosity. I would like to refresh my memory on the, hm, 'solar context'.' [Try a book with as much Mystery:  <sprite name=lantern> as their <sprite name=lantern> Interest.]

'I can still get to my Hattington, but I'll need bribes. And the lady I need to bribe - well, she has plenty of money, but she's, let's say, a gourmet…' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=grail> as their <sprite name=grail> Interest.]
'I can't believe this is a coincidence. The Obliviates are back in the world… and the Obliviates never come back to the world. Something is afoot in Port Noon.'
'I can't imagine how anyone might begin to heal his flesh. But if he decided he wants to speak with me, I have some inkling now of what I might need to understand. Thank you.'
'I did not know Zuthimalim Zidane. But I know enough who mourn for him. ' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=sky> as their <sprite name=sky> Interest.]
'I don't believe there's anything here. When times grow strange, people turn to religion. I think that's really all it is. Thank you for setting my mind at ease.'
'I don't like what they say happened. I don't like it at all.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=knock> as their <sprite name=knock> Interest.]
'I don't need what I'm here for… but I do need you to help me find it.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=moon> as their <sprite name=moon> Interest.]

'I don't pretend to be any kind of expert. But some of the details about their safeguards seem curious. I'm hoping your collection will help me look into that.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=forge> as their <sprite name=forge> Interest.]
'I fear this 'O.R.' has invited the attentions of the Mother of Ants. If so there is little I can do for him. But I can try. Thank you, Librarian.'
'I feel for the bloke. I do. But he's not just a bloke any more.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=heart> as their <sprite name=heart> Interest.]

'I had been planning to visit next autumn, to see Zuthi one more time… and now I'll never have the chance. However long one lives, one does not grow entirely accustomed to the suddenness of death.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=sky> as their <sprite name=sky> Interest.]
'I had read that honey is a part of the diet they offer in this place. I think now I understand the significance of this. Perhaps I will try it myself! Thank you, Librarian.'
'I have a contract in Kaunas, Librarian. For the Reckoner war. Which side? Does it matter?' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=edge> as their <sprite name=edge> Interest.]

'I have a general idea of what the Royal Endeavour entails, of course, but I would like to refresh my understanding of a few minor details.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=forge> as their <sprite name=forge> Interest.]

'I have a great many thoughts on this vault matter. A great many. I have not yet resolved upon a particular course. I am here to make a preliminary survey of the relevant literature.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=forge> as their <sprite name=forge> Interest.]
'I have a theory about how this quarrel began… I'd like to look into it, Librarian.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=moon> as their <sprite name=moon> Interest.]

'I have been asked to help the sufferers of a novel mania. They see shapes in the clouds - shapes that frighten and delight them. They wish to travel into the West. They insist. They grow violent…' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=sky> as their <sprite name=sky> Interest.]

'I have been charged to find this piebald garden in the ruins of Miah, and to pluck there a piebald rose… as a keepsake, I am told. My patron has been generous, but she is not merciful. Still this 'keepsake' business worries me. I would like to study the matter a little more.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=rose> as their <sprite name=rose> Interest.]
'I have been commissioned to write a piece, as a memorial… the themes are complex.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=sky> as their <sprite name=sky> Interest.]

'I have been offered a contract - to stalk Medusa, in Budapest. To stalk, not to hunt! I am not a fool.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=edge> or Mystery: <sprite name=rose> as their matching Interest.]

'I have heard of this venture in Germany, where the customers go in as bankers and come out as painters. I am not interested in bankers or in painting usually, but this…' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=heart> as their <sprite name=heart> Interest.]

'I have my own oracle from the Rising While. I believe I have a perfect understanding. I am here to make sure.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=scale>  as their <sprite name=scale> Interest.]

'I have no doubt at all that Zidane was murdered. But the motive confounds me. It was something to do with his work… or with the music he tried to teach it.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=sky> as their <sprite name=sky> Interest.]

'I have rather a knack for getting into things - I just need to see if any of this has been tried before -' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=knock> as their <sprite name=knock> Interest.]

'I have read of oracles like this 'Rising While', Librarian. Let me say this: they do not usually offer their services in times of peace and calm.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=scale>  as their <sprite name=scale> Interest.]

'I have sisters in the clouds above the Evening Isles. I think the monks of St Tentreto would know to avoid their attentions. And so I think there must be something else up there - something new, or old. I should inform myself before I travel to the Isles...'
